scope: first 100 eligible fresh episodes appended to the immutable random-200 pool; no physical collection, training, or validation execution is authorized by this artifact

pool.candidate_plan: one np.random.default_rng(1704) stream; draw 450 uniform yaws from [-pi/8,+pi/8], skip draws 0..299, apply draws 300..449 in order to seeds 2026123300..2026123449

training.initialization: fresh zero-control Constrain branch over exact frozen Base v1 EMA; never resume a prior Constrain update
training.selection: max random-validation successes among candidates retaining at least ceil(fresh_base_fixed_successes - 0.05*50) fixed; latest update breaks ties

validation.roster: fresh Base once per split plus each of six checkpoints on the same 50-scene random/fixed validation catalogs
validation.final_and_heldout_access: not implemented or authorized; remain closed regardless of this validation outcome

stop_rule.decision: if the 300-pool candidate set fails either unchanged method gate, stop this expansion study and report the negative result
